scope: Ticket 07 confirmation evidence and Ticket 08 fixed-task data plus from-scratch Base DP only; no Constrain/09 qualification

preflight_evidence.blinding: nonblind same-20-target confirmation; no generalization or policy-performance inference
preflight_evidence.training_exclusion: All 20 confirmation cases, all prior preflight cases, and all historical diagnostic cases are excluded from every training split.

data_collection.source: NativeEE teacher v4 exact registered source implementation and verified source SHA-256 identities
data_collection.action_conversion: None; preserve native 7-D source actions and observations exactly
data_collection.goal: fixed target yaw 0; preserve native charger and robot initialization
data_collection.eligibility: First 1000 ordered attempts for which both native expert source and raw-action replay pass official success, finite checks, and T+1 state/observation alignment; no outcome-dependent reordering or selection
data_collection.failed_attempts: Retain full attempt and raw source/replay artifacts; report attempted denominator and acceptance fraction; do not relabel failures.
data_collection.storage: Retain raw attempt subdirectories, plus consolidated training HDF5 and JSON manifest with authoritative ordered first 1000 eligible episodes.

base_policy.initialization: From scratch; official Diffusion Policy DPAgent; do not initialize from Peg 39-D checkpoint or custom adapter.
base_policy.updates_rationale: Freeze before collection/training: official Base budget is 100k; full-position/full-rotation Plug task and measured teacher lengths (249–349, median 309) warrant retaining that baseline budget rather than provisional 30k.
base_policy.normalization: Official identity observation/action normalization and native action bounds; no custom action codec.
base_policy.checkpoint_selection: Select only among the five preregistered checkpoints by maximum native-success count on frozen fixed validation 50; tie goes to latest update. Never inspect final test for selection.
base_policy.validation_gate: At least 40/50 successes on frozen fixed validation is required before opening the final test.
base_policy.base_qualification_gate: At least 80/100 successes on evaluation_catalogs.fixed_base_test_and_later_constrain_retention_seeds_inclusive (2026125100..2026125199), opened only after validation selection; no Peg continuation waiver. Constrain/09 training remains blocked until Base qualifies.

evaluation_catalogs.catalog_freeze: All catalogs, target yaws and reset-only scene metadata must be finalized before first optimizer update. Test outcomes remain unopened until validation checkpoint selection is locked.
evaluation_catalogs.future_constrain_rule: Correct hint is live charger-vs-goal yaw sin/cos. Fixed-standard hint is recomputed from actual current charger orientation and fixed goal yaw, not hardcoded to zero. Shuffled hints use a seed-1703 preregistered permutation of final goal assignments. No hidden goal fields or teacher feedback at policy inference.
evaluation_catalogs.future_adaptation_limits: 100 initial paired/random adaptation scenes after Base qualification; expansion to 200/300 only under a separately preregistered validation-based rule and evidence. No Constrain model/training authorized here.

future_method_gates_not_yet_passed.note: Exploratory position diagnostic does not replace official full-pose success; these are future gates, not results.

resource_limits.collection: No extension beyond 1500 candidates or 18000 s wall without a separate evidence-backed parent decision.
resource_limits.training: One seed-1 feasibility run only; no statistical scaling claim.
resource_limits.source_policy: No ManiSkill source changes without explicit user authorization.
